notes.title: Livestreaming our Demo of Decoy! 🌞
notes.content:
[h3]Welcome to join us as we livestream our currently available Demo for Decoy.[/h3]

[b]About the game:[/b]
Decoy is a fast paced story / action / adventure game, with modernized old school graphics and a lots of humor. Read more about Decoy on our [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/594390/Decoy/]store page[/url]

In this livestream, we will have a freind of ours play parts of the two first episodes and also try out the "score arena". We might also try out the arenas in multiplayer, we'll see! 🙃

The game is very much in development and still has a lot of rough edges. However, we hope that our livestream will give you a good glimpse of what Decoy is all about. 🌞

We also hope that you will try the free Demo for yourself and don't forget to [b]wishlist[/b]! 

Thank you! 🌷



https://store.steampowered.com/app/594390/Decoy/

notes.title: Demo available for Decoy
notes.content:
[h2]As part of the Steam Next Fest OCT 3-10th , we have a demo for Decoy available.[/h2] 

Decoy, is a fast-paced story / action / adventure - game, with modernized old school graphics and a lot of humor.

In this demo, you get to play the two first episodes, the training episode and episode one. As you play the two first episodes, you will also unlock three different arenas; race, survival and pickup. In the arenas, you can play for the highest score in the leaderboard or join up with friends in multiplayer.

The game is still very much in development and has a lot of rough edges.
Our hope is that a whole bunch of you will try it out and send us valuable feedback! :D

The Demo is only available during the Steam Next Fest, so don't wait! ;)


https://store.steampowered.com/app/594390/Decoy/
